method.contrast: same_sample_pair_mean - swapped_coefficient_pair_mean; equals -(Xbar_i-Xbar_j)@(beta_i-beta_j)/2, with parity cancelling
method.cross_fit: For each adjacent pair i,j, use beta_j with raw/control means from i and beta_i with means from j; average the two prices. No coefficient refit.
method.scope: Diagnoses the same-sample coefficient-fitting effect. It cannot validate control centering, F-control L2/integrability, time-grid bias, or unbiased continuous-model prices. No verified pointwise/global coverage or formal acceptance.
method.status: EXPLORATORY: specified after inspection of the first diagnostic, frozen before this calculation
method.uncertainty: Sample SD of the eight independent paired contrasts divided by sqrt(8); heuristic descriptive t7 interval. No nominal within-batch SE is used.
